items.title: An APR proof graph is acyclic exactly when the all-path reachability predicate is totally valid
items.author: Misaki Kojima; Naoki Nishida
items.source_version: FSCD2026 LIPIcs378 article19 official CC BY4.0 published PDF, Theorem6.3 and complete AppendixA proof pp19:22-19:23; corresponding native text from arXiv2602.04641v3 used only within the separately licensed published range
items.difficulty_reason: The author relates a finite cyclic proof graph with bud/companion links to all finite and infinite ARS execution paths. One direction lifts an unfulfilled execution into a proof-graph cycle; the converse extracts an infinite target-avoiding execution through the graph relation and equal source sets. The whole APR rule/graph construction and Proposition4.6-based proof continuation are retained, supporting H2 as a full liveness characterization rather than a graph-cycle test alone.
